lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) surveys across Niger to estimate populations in acute food insecurity under different scenarios. Population estimates were aggregated and compiled into time-series datasets for 2019, representing direct impacts of drought-driven food security crises on vulnerable populations.
